chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Chick Webb's Little Chicks; Van Alexander
summary: Webb and Cab Calloway formed small units; McRae identifies arranger Van Alexander.

bands.name: Chick Webb and His Little Chicks

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Now, he recorded under names. He had Chick Webb and His Orchestra, and Chick Webb and His Little Chicks.
Chick Webb and His Little Chicks is one of the things that I gave you. You know, those little records I gave you to copy?

Those are the records. 'If I Should Ever Leave' -- we made that a -- we took some of the big band stuff and we used this, we made a little small band. Remember the small bands were coming in? So Chick Webb formed himself a small band. You
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
also remember that Cab Calloway formed a small band called "The Cab Jivers."
I played in that when I went to join his band.
Who is Turk van Lake? I asked you about this person before. You remembered Van Alexander, but Turk van Lake apparently was an arranger.
I see. He arranged "I Want To Be Happy," and --
Yeah. He did quite a few things. He's writing for the movies now.
I saw him get a credit the other day. He's still out there in California. He get a picture every once in a while.
